```lean
intro R _ _ I hI
first
  | (have hne : I.minimalPrimes.Nonempty := by
       first
         | exact Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes hI
         | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_nonempty hI
         | exact Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes_of_ne_top hI
     obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
     haveI hpp : p.IsPrime := by
       first
         | exact hp.1.1
         | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_isPrime hp
         | exact hp.1.1.1
     have h1 : I.height ≤ p.height := by
       first
         | exact Ideal.height_le_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
         | exact Ideal.height_le_height_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
         | exact Ideal.height_mono hp.1.2
         | exact Ideal.height_le_height_of_le hp.1.2
         | exact Ideal.height_le_height hp.1.2
     have h2 : p.height ≤ Cardinal.toENat (Submodule.spanRank I) := by
       first
         | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes p hp
         | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
         | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes p hp
         | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes hp
         | (rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
            first
              | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes p hp
              | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
              | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes p hp
              | exact Ideal.primeHeight_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimal_primes hp)
     exact h1.trans h2)
  | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat I hI
  | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat hI
  | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat _ hI
  | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_ne_top I hI
  | exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_ne_top hI
```

```lean
intro A instA relations M instM instMod solution x
induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
| h0 => simp
| hadd f g hf hg => simp [hf, hg]
| hsingle r a =>
    have h := solution.linearCombination_var_relation r
    simp [Module.Relations.map, Module.Relations.Solution.π,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, h]
```

```lean
intro 𝕜 inst n inst1 A inst2 hA j
have h := Matrix.IsHermitian.apply_eigenvectorBasis hA j
have key : A.mulVec (WithLp.ofLp (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorBasis hA j))
    = WithLp.ofLp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorBasis hA j)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_apply]
rw [key, h]
funext i
first
| exact (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues hA j)
    (WithLp.ofLp (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorBasis hA j) i)).symm
| exact (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul _ _).symm
| simp [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
```
